name: Doorstep: property agents and portals
author: Claude (Get4Domain design)
description: Deep teal and warm gold for property agents and local portals: a split banner with an animated street of homes, a swinging For Sale board and a passing car, sale, rent and lease groups, a landing page for every property and a locality focus.

marketplace.licence: Theme code: for use by Get4Domain vendors on their vendor websites. Illustrations are original vector art made for this theme. Fonts: SIL OFL 1.1, self-hosted by the platform.

Doorstep home page on a phone: banner scene, listing links and bottom bar
